Name: psp_problem_solving_process
Title: Problem-Solving Process Management
ShortText: Allows you to create, read, and update problem-solving processes in SAP Digital Manufacturing for Issue Resolution.
Description: A problem-solving process is created in reference to a specific defect. You define containment actions, identify root causes, and specify corrective and preventive measures for a problem-solving process, using either the standard 8D methodology or a custom methodology. This API service allows you to create, read, and update problem-solving processes in SAP Digital Manufacturing for Issue Resolution.
